Gmail already has the tools. Mejl makes setup easy: a simple filter builder on Free, or describe a view and let Plus sort new mail. Your messages stay in Gmail. Web and iOS.

posts.name: VadeKit
posts.tagline: Offline OCR, spreadsheets, SQL, reports and more - no cloud
posts.description: Most OCR and "PDF-to-Excel" tools are web apps, your documents go to someone's server. VadeKit runs the whole pipeline on your machine. Drop a scanned PDF: on-device OCR extracts the text, layout and tables. Each table opens as a spreadsheet with formulas. Query across files with an offline SQL engine, chart it, and export a PDF report, no uploads. One toolkit, organised by task not by the library that powers it. No telemetry, no AI API. One-time purchase; Windows, macOS, Linux.

posts.name: NudgeBell
posts.tagline: Escalating reminders: any channel, set by you or your agent
posts.description: NudgeBell is a reminder you can't swipe away. Pick the channels you want, in the order you want, with the gaps you want: phone call, WhatsApp, SMS, email. One step or a chain, in your own words. Each step fires only if you ignored the one before. Acknowledge, and it stops. Your AI agent can set it too. NudgeBell exposes an MCP server your agent can connect to, so OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code or any agent can schedule the reminder for you. Start for Free, no credit card required!

posts.name: Bidway
posts.tagline: Where advertisers bid. Publishers earn more.
posts.description: Bidway connects website owners with advertisers who want visibility on their traffic. Set a minimum bid, let advertisers compete, and the highest bid takes the top spot on your site.

posts.name: ParetoScope
posts.tagline: Turn your data into 80/20 insights
posts.description: ParetoScope helps you find the 20% of your data driving 80% of your results. Analyze customers, products, channels, and activities to uncover what matters most. Turn complex data into clear, actionable insights with AI-powered analysis and advanced analytics. Spend less time searching through dashboards and more time focusing on the opportunities that make the biggest impact.

posts.name: unfollowmap
posts.tagline: See who unfollowed you on Instagram — without a login
posts.description: The free Instagram unfollow tracker that shows your mutuals, who doesn't follow you back, and who's unfollowed you — straight from your own Instagram export. No login, no password, no API calls — everything runs in your browser.

posts.name: shrl.io
posts.tagline: A privacy-first, self-hosted URL shortener & analyzer.
posts.description: A privacy-first, high-performance, self-hosted URL shortener and traffic analyzer designed for teams and individuals who want full control over their link data.

posts.name: Poptimum
posts.tagline: A daily optimization puzzle
posts.description: Poptimum is a daily puzzle game about packing cute fridge magnets as tightly as possible. Every day brings a fresh set of colorful magnets and a new shape to fill. Drag, rotate, and arrange them to squeeze out every bit of empty space, then see how your solution stacks up against players around the world. Play once a day, improve your packing, and see how close you can get to the world’s best score.

posts.name: Spicebag
posts.tagline: Compress crypto seed phrases into secure visual artifacts.
posts.description: Convert your crypto wallet seed phrases into decodable, cryptographically secure visual artifacts you can creatively store, scatter, and reassemble. BIP39, Electrum, SLIP39, all supported. Completely offline. Resists common visual exfiltrations such as photography and lossy data transfer.

posts.name: axonpush
posts.tagline: Replay production agent failures in CI. Block the merge.
posts.description: Change a prompt, a model, or one agent step, and nothing tells you whether it broke the last ten things that worked. So you ship it and watch. axonpush replays the production failures you have already had against every change, and fails the build when one comes back. Evals score the model call. axonpush replays the whole request: the tool that returned a 402, the retrieval that came back empty, the query that timed out. A CLI and a GitHub Action. Exit 1, a JUnit file, a PR comment.

posts.name: TwoPlates
posts.tagline: Meal planning for couples with different nutrition goals
posts.description: TwoPlates creates one shared weekly meal plan for two adults with different nutrition goals, with personalised portions and one practical shopping list.

posts.name: PocketBase Cloud
posts.tagline: Host unlimited apps at a fixed price
posts.description: Database, auth, auto-generated API, realtime, storage, cronjob, frontends and backends. One platform, one CLI, one bill.

posts.name: FRAME 37 — film camera for your phone.
posts.tagline: Two films in one camera — Frame 37’s biggest update yet
posts.description: Frame 37 brings the feeling of shooting real film to your phone. Load a roll, shoot without previews, rewind, and wait for development. This update introduces a redesigned camera and film library, a new film stock, and the ability for PRO users to keep two different rolls loaded and switch between them while shooting.

posts.name: Lock In Cert
posts.tagline: A 30-day exam readiness system for IT certifications.
posts.description: Lock In Cert is a 30-day study planner built specifically for IT certification exams — CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Linux+, CCNA, and cloud certs. It structures your final month into a daily plan, tracks practice exam progress, and keeps you focused on weak spots instead of re-reviewing what you already know.

posts.name: Whos1
posts.tagline: 🏆 RankWar | Transparent Pay-to-Rank Leaderboards
posts.description: RankWar is a radical rethinking of how products get ranked and discovered. The Problem: Algorithms are black boxes Rankings disappear overnight Visibility depends on luck You never know why you ranked #1 or #50 The Solution: Transparent ranking where money = position. That's it.

posts.name: Hutif - MCP server generator
posts.tagline: Turn files, databases, and APIs into hosted MCP servers
posts.description: Connect a table, database, API, or set of documents and get a live MCP server back in minutes - schema detected automatically, no code required.

posts.name: Bodhi
posts.tagline: AI Coding Desktop Code Editor
posts.description: Bodhi is a next-generation lightweight desktop code editor engineered with Monaco Editor, zero-lag native terminal, instant file watching, and zero telemetry.

posts.name: ReSocks
posts.tagline: Relay your SOCKS5 over TLS with TUN & app routing
posts.description: Bring your own SOCKS5 proxy and make it more flexible with ReSocks. Connect to your existing SOCKS5 through a secure TLS relay while keeping your chosen proxy as the final exit. Use TUN mode to route traffic system-wide, or create per-app and website rules to choose what goes through the proxy and what connects directly. Share proxy access with devices on your LAN, choose from global relay locations, or deploy your own relay for complete control.
